- Recurrence: weekly on Mondays at 11:00 AM (America/Los_Angeles)
- Attendee: devlead@example.com
- Requested action: cancel the entire recurring series (all future occurrences) and send attendee notifications

Please confirm one of the following exactly:
1) "Confirm — cancel series and notify attendees" (I will cancel the whole series and send cancellations)
2) "Confirm — cancel series, do NOT notify attendees" (I will cancel without sending notifications)
3) Or tell me any changes (different scope/message/attendees)

If you confirm, do you want to include a custom cancellation message to attendees? If so, paste the message; otherwise I'll send a standard cancellation.
